title: Choose the visual world for ras.ruchi
question: The roll assigned The Working Sketchbook. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Working Sketchbook
options.lineage: A textile student's black-paper sketchbook: gouache studies, taped swatches, tracing-paper motif overlays (NID process journals).
options.thesis: The site is Shruchi's own sketchbook: every collection opens the way she builds it, from what she saw, to the motif, to the cloth.
options.viewport: One open spread on a single gutter: left page carries the hand-set name and today's gouache swatches (Rasaa's brick red, herb green, zari gold); right page is a full-bleed photograph of her cloth taped in, with a tracing-paper sheet over it showing the motif drawn out.
options.risk: Can tip into scrapbook kitsch if the tape and pins become decoration instead of structure.

raised.raise: Spreads are cut as separate blocks with real gaps of bare paper between them, not one continuous scroll.
Every work carries a hairline-ruled margin note naming craft, place and community, set like an apparatus, never as a caption card.
Selecting one design isolates it on the spread and dims the rest, so a 66-design collection can be read one piece at a time.
Nothing is boxed: no cards, no frames, no rules around work; the cloth sits straight on the paper.

options.label: The Shade Card
options.lineage: Textile mill shade cards and swatch books: pinked swatches pinned to card, each with colourway codes.
options.thesis: Every design is shown the way a mill shows cloth: as swatches in all its colourways, which you flip to see the room change.
options.viewport: A wide shade card of Rasaa: twelve pinked swatches in a row, the name as the card's printed header, one swatch lifted to show the cloth in a room.
options.risk: The most familiar route for a textile portfolio; reads like a catalogue if the stories don't break through.

options.label: Layered Window
options.lineage: Multiplane cel animation, fused with her combo curtains: sheer, print and solid hung in layers at a window.
options.thesis: The page is a dressed window: her sheer, print and solid move as separate planes, and scrolling racks focus from cloth to room.
options.viewport: A window filling the screen: a sheer drifting slowly in front, her printed curtain behind it, the room glowing beyond; the name sits on the nearest plane.
options.case: Strongest audience identification (it is literally how her cloth lives in a home); loses on clarity because motion and layering can bury the work itself.
options.risk: Heavy motion; needs careful fallbacks so the photographs stay the hero.

options.label: Block-printed Broadsheet
options.lineage: Penny-press relief broadsides, fused with her Kalamkari and Ajrak block printing and the Chitrakatha comic bag.
options.thesis: Each project is printed as one sheet: a relief image band in a single ink, her own story set tight in two columns below.
options.viewport: A full sheet: 'ras.ruchi' in mixed wood type, an indigo-printed image band of Sura's motifs, and two dense columns of her words beneath.
options.case: Holds identification (block printing is her craft); loses on clarity because a single-ink treatment fights how much colour her work carries.
options.risk: Can read as a poster homage rather than a portfolio of colourful cloth.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Sections cut from weather and assembled.
options.viewport: A cliff of cut cloud blocks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing in her world or her visitors' world maps to weather quarrying.
options.kept: Sections cut as distinct blocks with real gaps between them.
options.risk: Surreal costume with no tie to cloth.

options.label: Centre-rail Edition
options.thesis: Two columns around a rail of keys with marginal apparatus.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too text-led for work that is mostly image and colour.
options.kept: A hairline margin apparatus that credits craft, place and community on every work.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Works as tracks radiating from one event.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scientific coldness against warm handwork.
options.kept: Select one piece to isolate it and dim the rest.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap text over a drifting void.
options.viewport: One line of text on black.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to textiles.
options.kept: Nothing boxed: no cards or frames around the work.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white gallery portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name top-left, a large image, a grid of projects below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other designer portfolio by design.
